title: Improved send timestamp presentation in HiPerConTracer dissector.
description:
Added additional output formats for the send timestamp, to allow for easier
filtering when comparing PCAP traces and HiPerConTracer results files:
Unix timestamp in seconds, Unix timestamp in nanoseconds, raw value.
